name: Rate-Constrained Quantization
definition: Quantization strategy for TT cores $\mathbf{Q}_{1i}, \mathbf{Q}_{2i}$ and biases $\mathbf{b}_i$ using uniform 16-bit for biases and non-uniform k-means quantization for cores, applied sequentially with fine-tuning.
summary: Rate-Constrained Quantization compresses NeRF models by applying a global codebook to Tensor Train weights and using sequential fine-tuning to mitigate error accumulation.
